items.headline: Your OOS Defines the Rules. Your Runtime Enforces Them. You Need Both.
items.summary: There was a comment on one of my posts that disappeared, but needed answering. The way we frame it: the OOS (Organizational Operating System) defines WHAT the rules are -- which actions require approval, what cost thresholds trigger escalation, how agents resolve authority conflicts, where automation stops and human judgment begins. items.headline: I built an MCP server that gives Claude access to my game saves
items.summary: Hello r/ClaudeAI! I'm sharing my solo project, built entirely with Claude Code -- including the demo video (authored with Claude's help in Remotion). Savecraft is an MCP server that parses your savegame files and gives Claude full context on your character: gear, stats, skills, quest progress, everything.
